Question: Why does the UTS app (Indian Railway unreserved ticketing app) not work inside the stations?
Answer: Railways is more intelligent than us. If UTS app will be available at stations then most of the people will not purchase the ticket . When people will see any TC checking the ticket they will immediately purchase a platform ticket ( because it is cheapest) and will show that to the TC to go out from the station . I know few people are honest, they will purchase the proper ticket but there is no doubt that people will also misuse this feature. Keeping this in mind , Railways do not allow passengers to use the UTS app near or at the stations. Thank you for reading the answer.

Question: Why IRCTC shows only 3 available seats for 1st class and only 13 seats available for 2 tier AC coach for Netaji Express/Kalka mail (12311) for all dates? Can I book 4 first class tickets through IRCTC?
